# ResourceReader

*Block · readers · `linecaster.blocks.readers`*

Fetches the remote files of items as they are served, one document per resource, one item per task.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Unit | item |
| Role | reader |
| Reads | - |
| Adds | `metadata` |
| Replaces | - |
| Comes after | - |
| Comes before | [`ImageConverter`](../conversion/ImageConverter.md), [`ImageFetcher`](../conversion/ImageFetcher.md), [`TranscriptionConverter`](../conversion/TranscriptionConverter.md), [`ResourceRecordWriter`](../writers/ResourceRecordWriter.md) |
| Used in | - |
| Source | [resources.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/src/linecaster/blocks/readers/resources.py) |

The contract is that of `ResourceReader(data_folder='items/', item_key='lccn', templates={'marcxml': 'https://lccn.loc.gov/{item}/marcxml'})`; the comes-after and comes-before rows are derived from every block's contract.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data_folder` | `DataFolderLike` | required | the Parquet files (a folder, or the folder of `glob_pattern`'s file). |
| `item_key` | `str` | required | the column with each row's item id. |
| `templates` | `dict[str, str] \| None` | `None` | kind -> URL template with `{item}`; default: the table names its resources (`url_key`). |
| `url_key` | `str` | `'url'` | the table's columns for a resource's URL, kind and copy name (without `templates`; `name_key` optional). |
| `kind_key` | `str` | `'kind'` | the table's columns for a resource's URL, kind and copy name (without `templates`; `name_key` optional). |
| `name_key` | `str \| None` | `None` | the table's columns for a resource's URL, kind and copy name (without `templates`; `name_key` optional). |
| `http` | `dict \| None` | `None` | `linecaster.net.http.HTTPFetcher` settings for every host (rate limits, proxies, ...). |
| `http_policy` | `str \| None` | `None` | an HTTP policy file (`linecaster.net.policy`): settings for every host under `http`'s, a host's own over both. |
| `reuse_folder` | `DataFolderLike \| None` | `None` | where `ResourceFilesWriter` writes (`OUT`): a resource whose copy is there is read back (one listing per item and kind, `linecaster.blocks.readers.existing`; one that takes over `LISTING_TIMEOUT`, 60 s, or fails is a warning and a stat, `reuse_listing_timeouts` or `reuse_listing_errors`, and the item's resources are fetched again). |
| `max_items` | `int \| None` | `None` | only the first `max_items` items of the input, for the whole run (a smoke test). |
| `paths_file` | `DataFileLike \| None` | `None` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `glob_pattern` | `str` | `'**/*.parquet'` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `recursive` | `bool` | `True` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `limit` | `int` | `-1` | resources per task, as datatrove's count documents; they apply before anything is fetched. |
| `skip` | `int` | `0` | resources per task, as datatrove's count documents; they apply before anything is fetched. |
| `file_progress` | `bool` | `False` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `doc_progress` | `bool` | `False` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `default_metadata` | `dict \| None` | `None` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |
| `shuffle_files` | `bool` | `False` | datatrove's `BaseDiskReader` arguments. |

## Behavior

The input is Parquet (`data_folder`): one row per resource (`url_key` and `kind_key`, optionally
`name_key`), or rows naming items and `templates` that give each item's URL per kind (`{item}` is replaced
by the item id). The copy's name is `name_key`'s value, else the item id (with `templates`) or the URL's last
path segment. `auto_tasks` is the number of items. See the module docstring for the record, the checks, the
HTTP policy and the reuse.
